Hi Olivia — thanks for the detail and the attachment. Short answers up front: yes on a one-off top-up with pro-rata billing; yes we can convert to a co-termed uplift. Below are two operational options and the pricing impact: 

Option A — Temporary top-up (fast):
- One-off bucket purchase for the excess tokens billed at current overage rate (no long-term commit).
- No discount; immediate provisioning (same-day in most cases).
- Good if you want minimal paperwork and quick relief.

Option B — Staged uplift -> Co-term conversion (recommended for predictability):
- Immediate staged uplift to cover the next 3 months with 6% uplift discount applied to the top-up portion.
- If you convert to a committed uplift for the rest of the year within 45 days, we will credit the staged top-up amounts and apply an additional 6% co-term discount (totaling ~12% on uplifted capacity when annualized).
- Commit path requires a short SOW amendment and signature.

I've attached a pricing grid with example math for your 1.2M/month scenario. High-level ask from us: please confirm whether you want the temporary bucket or the staged uplift path so we can put the right SOW in motion.

Next steps I recommend:
1) If you need capacity today, choose Option A.
2) If you prefer cost predictability, pick Option B and we'll prepare the amendment and the DocuSign link.

I"m looping in Priyom so RevOps can prepare the SOW and DocuSign flow.

—Michael
